subject: Fuel system inspection
summary: Mandatory inspection of fuel selector valve assembly P/N 0556124-2 on Cessna 172 R/S models due to reports of internal leakage. Compliance: within 100 hours TIS or 12 months, whichever occurs first.

subject: Wing strut corrosion
summary: Inspection of wing strut attach fittings on Cessna 172 model years 1996 through 2010 for corrosion. Compliance: within 50 flight hours.

subject: Aileron control rod inspection
summary: Inspection of aileron push-pull control rods on Piper PA-28 (Cherokee/Warrior/Archer) due to reported cases of fatigue cracking. Compliance: every 1000 flight hours.

subject: V-tail attach bolt inspection
summary: Recurring inspection of V-tail attach bolts on Beechcraft Bonanza models 35 through V35B. Compliance: every 500 hours TIS, with replacement at 5000 hours TT.

subject: Carburetor heat box inspection
summary: Inspection of carburetor heat box assembly on Cessna 182 models with O-470 series engines for evidence of corrosion or cracking. Compliance: at next annual inspection.

subject: CAPS (parachute) rocket motor
summary: Replacement of CAPS rocket motor on Cirrus SR22 aircraft serial numbers 0001 through 4500 due to potential degradation with age. Compliance: within 10 years from manufacture date.

subject: Float gear attach
summary: Inspection of float gear attach fittings on amphibious Cessna 206 with floats installed. Specific concern for high-cycle bush operations. Compliance: every 250 hours.

subject: Engine mount cracking
summary: Inspection of engine mount tubes on Piper PA-32 (Cherokee Six / Saratoga / Lance) at intake-exhaust-system region. Compliance: every 100 hours.

subject: Landing gear actuator
summary: Replacement of landing gear actuator on Mooney M20 J, K, M models with serial numbers 24-0001 through 25-3252. Compliance: within 100 hours or at next annual.

subject: Caravan turbine engine FOD inspection
summary: Pre-flight inspection of PT6A engine inlet for foreign object damage (FOD) on Cessna 208 Caravan, particularly in bush operations and unimproved-field environments. Compliance: each preflight.

subject: Magneto impulse coupling
summary: Inspection and possible replacement of magneto impulse coupling on Cessna 172 with O-320 engines, manufactured 2015-2020. Compliance: within 25 flight hours.

subject: Wing spar inspection
summary: Detailed inspection of wing spar assemblies on DHC-2 Beaver aircraft operating in float and ski configurations, particularly Alaskan operators with high-cycle service. Compliance: within 200 hours.

subject: Engine cowling latch
summary: Replacement of engine cowling latches on DHC-3 Otter aircraft to prevent in-flight separation. Compliance: within 25 flight hours.

subject: Tailwheel spring
summary: Inspection of tailwheel spring assembly on Cessna 185 Skywagon, particularly aircraft with high-frequency rough-strip operations common in AK bush flying. Compliance: every 100 hours.

subject: Lift strut fittings
summary: Inspection of lift strut fittings and brace wires on Piper PA-18 Super Cub aircraft, especially those operating on tundra tires or skis with significant unprepared-surface use. Compliance: every 100 hours.
